subject: Offline image endorsement and acceptance — operator proofpoint & signing
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Anita Ramesh <anita.ramesh@acmecorp.com>, Brian Holt <brian.holt@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Offline image endorsement and acceptance — operator proofpoint & signing

Hi Anita / Brian,

Following our call last week, attached is the shipment manifest and the signed artifact for the air-gapped image we intend to hand over to your operator team for acceptance testing. This thread captures the acceptance criteria, operator proofpoint steps, and post-acceptance custody handoff we discussed.

High-level ask: please confirm that Acme can run the acceptance checklist (section A below) during the 11/18 acceptance window and that the operator will keep a single signed custody log (paper + scanned) per our chain-of-custody template.

Attachments: manifest-20261116.json, offline-image-v2.1.tar.gz.sig, acceptance-test-report-20261116.pdf

Acceptance checklist (summary):
- Verify signature (Ed25519) against our public key (sha256 thumbprint included in manifest).
- Validate manifest hashes for all partitions and the bootloader.
- Run smoke acceptance tests in isolated network (we provide a deterministic test harness, step list in the attached report).
- Operator to record: time of unpack, operator id, device serials, and final image hash in custody ledger.

Operational notes:
- The signed image is detached-sig (.sig). Please use the verification command in the manifest.
- If any hash mismatch or verification failure occurs, STOP and capture logs (do not power-cycle devices). We will triage remotely.
- Emergency rollback: manifest contains a cryptographic revocation statement; we will transmit signed revocation to your security mailbox if rollback is required.

Next steps:
1) Acme confirms acceptance window 11/18 09:00-12:00 PT.
2) Operator rehearsal date (preferred): 11/17 14:00 PT — we can run the verification steps with your operator via VPNless guidance.

Thanks — I will be on standby during the acceptance window and Marissa will coordinate logistics.

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Principal Product Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
[t] +1 415 555 0123
[Attachment: manifest-20261116.json (application/json)]

From: Anita Ramesh <anita.ramesh@acmecorp.com>

Cc: Brian Holt <brian.holt@acmecorp.com>, Acme Security <security@acmecorp.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Offline image endorsement and acceptance — operator proofpoint & signing

Thanks Tessa — looks good. A couple quick clarifying questions before we lock the rehearsal: 

1) Signature algorithm — you mention Ed25519 in the manifest; can you confirm the public key is the rotating key fingerprint we received in Oct? We need to map to our HSM policy.
2) The acceptance harness references a deterministic nonce for test vectors — will we get that prior to the rehearsal so we can preload it into our test bench?

We can tentatively confirm 11/18 09:00-12:00 PT for acceptance. Rehearsal on 11/17 14:00 PT works for our lead operator (Brian) if you can stand up a screen-share walkthrough (no network access required by us).

Also, can you attach the signed revocation template so our security lead knows how you will signal an emergency rollback?

-Anita
Anita Ramesh
Director, Infrastructure Operations
Acme Corp
[Attachment: none]

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Anita Ramesh <anita.ramesh@acmecorp.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Offline image endorsement and acceptance — operator proofpoint & signing

Hi Anita — quick answers inline: 

> 1) Signature algorithm — you mention Ed25519 in the manifest; can you confirm the public key is the rotating key fingerprint we received in Oct? We need to map to our HSM policy.

Correct — the public key fingerprint in the manifest is the Oct 2026 rotating signing key: SHA256:AA:9F:...:C3 (shortened here). We will also publish the key to our customer KMS endpoint and provide a signed key-certificate bundle before rehearsal. Use the KMS bundle to pin the key in your HSM policy.

> 2) The acceptance harness references a deterministic nonce for test vectors — will we get that prior to the rehearsal so we can preload it into our test bench?

Yes — the acceptance-test-report-20261116.pdf includes the nonce table for each device SKU. I'll attach the nonce table and a short verification script (bash) you can run in air-gapped mode; it performs signature verify, hash checks, and executes the smoke vectors.

Attached: acceptance-test-report-20261116.pdf (contains nonce table), offline-image-v2.1.tar.gz.sig (detached signature).

Operator checklist (expanded):
- Confirm manifest fingerprint matches the KMS bundle.
- Run: redwood-verify --manifest manifest-20261116.json --sig offline-image-v2.1.tar.gz.sig --pubkey redwood-acme-202611.pem
- Unpack image using operator account (operator id recorded).
- Run smoke vectors from report in isolated environment; capture stdout/stderr to acceptance log.
- Create custody ledger entry and perform two-factor custody attestation (operator + witness).

If you want, Marissa and I can produce a minimal acceptance-runbook (one-page) for your ops desk before rehearsal.

-David
David Kim
Principal Engineer, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: acceptance-test-report-20261116.pdf (application/pdf), offline-image-v2.1.tar.gz.sig (application/octet-stream)]

From: Anita Ramesh <anita.ramesh@acmecorp.com>

Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Offline image endorsement and acceptance — operator proofpoint & signing

David — thanks, that helps. We reviewed the test report and the nonce table; Brian confirmed he can run the script in our secure staging. A couple items for the rehearsal: 

- Please publish the redwood-acme-202611.pem bundle to the shared Drive link (we need the bundled cert chain).
- We will use a sealed room for acceptance; operator will be accompanied by a witness from Security and will follow the two-factor custody attestation you described.
- For emergency rollback protocol, can you confirm the exact subject line and signature format you'll send to security@acmecorp.com so our ticketing automation can trigger the rollback playbook?

We will be ready for the rehearsal 11/17 14:00 PT; acceptance remains 11/18 09:00-12:00 PT.

-Anita

Anita / Brian — thanks for running rehearsal this morning and for the quick acceptance. Per the acceptance logs you shared:

- Signature verified (Ed25519) against redwood-acme-202611.pem fingerprint.
- All manifest hashes matched.
- Smoke vectors passed (see attached acceptance-test-report-20261116.pdf).
- Custody ledger completed: operator Brian H., witness Sandra K. (Acme Security). scanned ledger stored at the Drive link below.

Final steps we executed:
1) Manifest + signed bundle uploaded to shared Drive: https://drive.redwood/Acme/airgap/20261116/manifest
2) We posted DocuSign acceptance envelope for the image release (link: https://docsign.example/ds/ZX-34912)
3) We delivered the signed revocation template to security@acmecorp.com with subject line: [REDWOOD REVOCATION] image-v2.1 revocation — SHA256:<short> (this is the canonical message format; stubbed for automation).

If you want a post-acceptance artefacts package (flattened logs + zipped ledger + signed manifest) we can push an encrypted tarball to the courier and add a handover receipt.

Thanks again — closing the acceptance on our side. Marissa will follow up with the formal sign-off doc and next artefacts to ship.

Cheers,

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Deployments
Redwood Inference
